info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Corporate Trust Services Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about specific corporate trust services based on a given parameter. This API supports retrieval of critical service attributes and client data, which is essential for clients seeking trust solutions for their banking needs. Typical consumers include financial institutions, corporate legal teams, and compliance officers needing timely access to trust service offerings. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can streamline their decision-making processes related to corporate trust services.

get.summary: Retrieve Corporate Trust Service data by ID.
